environment: SQLite local synthetic fixtures; cloud-scope.json confirms workflow enabled; no MySQL claim

method.baseline: Loaded historical backend/apps/workflows/serializers.py from baseline SHA with git show and dynamically executed it as apps.workflows._baseline_serializers during the local acceptance run. Direct historical execution captured the 20-row per-endpoint count; its unchanged legacy fallback was separately captured at 2 rows and 20 rows.
method.optimized: CaptureQueriesContext around each authenticated collection API request at 2 and 20 synthetic rows. JSON compared with the historical serializer in the same dataset, ordering, and run.
method.response_hash: SHA-256 of canonical JSON response (synthetic fixture only).

edge_cases: same resource_id in another tenant is excluded
limitations: SQLite evidence validates local semantics and query counts only; no MySQL timing or plan evidence.
sample_data: Synthetic fixtures only; response hashes contain no production data.
